label: early input right after a 3, in sequences starting with x (esp. after 3 3, or z after 3)
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.002% of steps). Fires in the original phase at steps 3-5 (most at t=4). It depends on a conjunction: the first original token is x (93% of mass), the previous input is the digit 3 (83% of mass), and often the token two back is also 3. The input token is often z (45% of mass, 15x lift). Activations are largest for the pattern x ? 3 3 [tok] and for z right after 3; the top example is x a 3 3 [z]. It almost never fires in the copy phase, and fires on the delimiter only weakly. Context alone is not enough: x ... 3 followed by some other token is usually inactive, so precision is low unless 3 3 or z is also required. Best predicate: dev F1 0.48, mass recall 0.62. A few weak activations come from non-x starts (e.g. n f 3 3 z) or from z with no 3 just before it.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 20 cues. Raise it: orig0=x (+4.50), prev_tok=3 (+2.87), prev2_tok=3 (+2.14), phase=0 & in_tok=z (+1.76), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=z (+1.76), orig1=i (+1.70). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-2.03), phase=2 (-1.08), in_first=0 (-1.06), orig_idx=-1 (-1.05).
